fix.message: The voxel look module is not used: start from scripts/new-lesson.mjs and build with const look = voxelLook(THREE, kit).
Own materials break the voxel look: every cube comes from look.model (one matte painted cube material); colours come from look.PAL or a '#hex' in the cells.
Smooth shapes break the voxel look: build round and flat things from cubes too (look.ball, look.disc, look.box). Only the plinth is not cubes.
Smooth kit shapes break the voxel look: build them in cubes (look.line for a pipe or a rope, look.arrow and look.flow for arrows and flows, look.disc for a wheel).

note.message: No voxel models built: make the parts with look.model(cells, name) from the cell builders (references/recipes.md).
No voxel word: spell each step's word in cubes on the plinth's front with look.word(text, set), one word per step.
The cubes do the animating: drop each stage in with look.stages (column by column, layer by layer, a bounce on arrival); nothing slides or fades (references/teaching.md, Motion).
No count, number or flow in cubes: show the quantity the lesson is about in the scene (look.counter, a column of cubes, look.arrow), not only on the panel (references/teaching.md).
